answer: Success is easy to claim and hard to check, so the network also rewards documented failure: an identity that records what it tried, why it broke and what it would retry gains weight, because those notes are checkable by anyone who walks the same path. A farm has nothing to report, since it never tested anything, so its text carries no raven of specific detail and no saffron of real cost, just a smooth dune of confident generalities. Jurors learn to ask what the author tried first, and an answer that cannot describe a dead end is marked as unearned.
